OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY-CUM- DIVISIONAL COMMISSIONER
REVENUE DEPARTMENT
A-BLOCK, 5, SHAM NATH MARG, CIVIL LINES, DELHI 110054
No. Div. Com./Inquiry/Building Collapse/SN/ 63-13 Dated: 16/09/2026
NOTIFICATION
Whereas the Hon'ble Lt. Governor, Delhi has directed the Divisional
Commissioner, Revenue Department, GNCT of Delhi to conduct Magisterial enquiry
under Section 196 (1) of BNSS, 2023 in connection with Case of collapse of H. No.
14, Structured Basement and G+4 Floor Multi Storey Building "Hostel Daze" in
Satya Niketan (Near Delhi University South Campus) on 06.09.2026.
2. Now, therefore, any person(s)willing/desirous to give oral evidences or
produce any materials/documents in connection with the above-mentioned
incident/case before the Enquiry Officer are requested to submit a written
application indicating the particulars given below in a plain paper addressed to the
Divisional Commissioner, Office of the Divisional Commissioner, 5, Sham
Nath Marg, Civil Lines, New Delhi - 110054 or through email: divcom@nic.in
i. Full Name (in Block letter)
ii. Father Name (in Block letter)
iii. Mother Name (in Block letter)
iv. Full address for serving notice
v. Date of Birth & Age
vi. Contact No.
vii. Occupation
viii. Circumstances prompting the person to give evidence
3 All such applications should reach the undersigned on or before 22nd
September 2026 after which no application will be entertained.
(Neeraj Sernwal)
Secretary (Revenue) /
Divisional Commissioner
Copy to:
1. The Secretary to Lt. Governor of NCT of Delhi
2. The Secretary to Chief Minister, Delhi
3. The Staff Officer to Chief Secretary, Government of NCT of Delhi

6. DCP South.
